generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A nominal implementation can pass local happy paths while derived aggregates mix incompatible dimensions, rolling decisions lack required history, or persisted policy and approval state is not consumed by the runtime that enforces it.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Validate isolated records and one-step mutations without testing competing units, prior-window dependencies, derived representations, persisted policy effects, authenticated actor identity, or chained bounded transitions.
trigger_signals: derived metric combines independently dimensioned values
decision rule depends on prior windows
persisted grant or hold should alter later execution
bounded extension requires another authorized actor
emergency mode has an exceptional temporal allowance

reusable_control.procedure: Attack comparable dimensions, rolling lookback, persisted-policy consumption, derived representations, authenticated approval chains, and exceptional temporal windows before handoff.

generalized_learning.prevention_rule: Delivery must test the material cross-dimension and cross-time destination where a persisted or aggregated decision actually takes effect, not only the producer mutation.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: Independent review must reconstruct derived inputs and persisted state chains with deliberately divergent values and prior/future states before accepting nominal outputs.
